rules.title: fs.exists is deprecated
rules.summary: Node.js documents fs.exists(path, callback) as deprecated (DEP0034, documentation-only since v1.0.0).

constraints: Keep the behavior of the call unchanged; check the replacement's argument and error handling differences.

steps.title: Replace fs.exists
steps.instructions: Replace each reported fs.exists call with fs.access or fs.stat and handle the error instead of the boolean.

verification.purpose: Run the repository tests when defined.

rules.title: The Buffer() constructor is deprecated
rules.summary: Node.js deprecates calling Buffer() or new Buffer() in application code (DEP0005): documentation-only since v6.0.0, runtime warning since v10.0.0.

constraints: Keep the behavior of the call unchanged; check the replacement's argument and error handling differences.

steps.title: Replace the Buffer constructor
steps.instructions: Use Buffer.from for existing data, Buffer.alloc for zero-filled memory, and Buffer.allocUnsafe only when the content is overwritten immediately.

verification.purpose: Run the repository tests when defined.

rules.title: util.isArray is deprecated
rules.summary: Node.js deprecates util.isArray() (DEP0044): documentation-only since v4.0.0, runtime warning since v22.0.0.

constraints: Keep the behavior of the call unchanged; check the replacement's argument and error handling differences.

steps.title: Replace util.isArray
steps.instructions: Replace each reported util.isArray(x) with Array.isArray(x).

verification.purpose: Run the repository tests when defined.

rules.title: util._extend is deprecated
rules.summary: Node.js deprecates util._extend() (DEP0060): documentation-only since v6.0.0, runtime warning since v22.0.0.

constraints: Keep the behavior of the call unchanged; check the replacement's argument and error handling differences.

steps.title: Replace util._extend
steps.instructions: Replace each reported util._extend(target, source) with Object.assign(target, source).

verification.purpose: Run the repository tests when defined.

rules.title: util.isString has been removed
rules.summary: Node.js removed util.isString() (DEP0045 to DEP0058 group, end-of-life since v23.0.0), so calls throw a TypeError.

sources.title: Node.js deprecations: DEP0045 to DEP0058 util.is* functions

constraints: Keep the behavior of the call unchanged; check the replacement's argument and error handling differences.

steps.title: Replace util.isString
steps.instructions: Replace each reported util.isString(x) with typeof x === 'string'.

verification.purpose: Run the repository tests when defined.

rules.title: url.parse is deprecated
rules.summary: Node.js deprecates url.parse() because its behavior is not standardized and error-prone with security implications (DEP0169): documentation-only since v19.0.0 and v18.13.0, application runtime warning since v24.0.0.
rules.replacement: The WHATWG URL API, new URL()

constraints: Keep the behavior of the call unchanged; check the replacement's argument and error handling differences.

steps.title: Replace url.parse
steps.instructions: Parse with new URL(input, base) and read its properties instead of the legacy url object; review inputs that are not absolute URLs.

verification.purpose: Run the repository tests when defined.

rules.title: crypto.createCipher and createDecipher have been removed
rules.summary: Node.js removed crypto.createCipher() and crypto.createDecipher() because they use a weak key derivation (MD5, no salt) and static IVs (DEP0106, end-of-life since v22.0.0).
rules.replacement: crypto.createCipheriv() and crypto.createDecipheriv(), with keys from crypto.scrypt() or crypto.pbkdf2() and random salts

constraints: Keep the behavior of the call unchanged; check the replacement's argument and error handling differences.

steps.title: Switch to the iv variants
steps.instructions: Derive the key with crypto.scrypt and a random salt, generate a random IV, and call createCipheriv or createDecipheriv; existing ciphertext needs a decryption-then-reencrypt migration.

verification.purpose: Run the repository tests when defined.

rules.title: process.binding is deprecated
rules.summary: Node.js documents process.binding() as for internal use only and deprecates it (DEP0111, documentation-only since v10.9.0); it is unavailable when the permission model is enabled.
rules.replacement: The public API that replaces the binding in use; the entry names no single replacement

constraints: Keep the behavior of the call unchanged; check the replacement's argument and error handling differences.

steps.title: Replace process.binding
steps.instructions: Identify which internal binding is requested and move to its public module, for example util.types.

verification.purpose: Run the repository tests when defined.

rules.title: The recursive option of fs.rmdir has been removed
rules.summary: Node.js removed the recursive option of fs.rmdir() and fs.rmdirSync() (DEP0147: documentation-only since v14.14.0, runtime since v16.0.0, end-of-life since v25.0.0).

constraints: Keep the behavior of the call unchanged; check the replacement's argument and error handling differences.

steps.title: Use fs.rm
steps.instructions: Replace fs.rmdir(path, { recursive: true }) with fs.rm(path, { recursive: true, force: true }), and the sync form with fs.rmSync.

verification.purpose: Run the repository tests when defined.

rules.title: tls.createSecurePair has been removed
rules.summary: Node.js removed tls.createSecurePair() (DEP0064: documentation-only since v6.0.0, runtime since v8.0.0, end-of-life since v24.0.0).

constraints: Keep the behavior of the call unchanged; check the replacement's argument and error handling differences.

steps.title: Use tls.TLSSocket
steps.instructions: Wrap the underlying socket with new tls.TLSSocket(socket, options).

verification.purpose: Run the repository tests when defined.
